machine.label: Developer workstation (Linux 6.18, x86_64)
machine.note: Competitor figures will be measured on this same machine by tools/bench-compare.sh.

methodology: Lumen numbers come from the repository's own regression tests (src/perf.rs, run with cargo test --release perf -- --nocapture) and from the status bar's PSS counter (proportional set size, which counts shared pages fairly). Frame and keystroke times are CPU time of the UI thread for one software-rendered 1100x700 frame, not end-to-end input-to-photon latency. Competitor columns stay empty until the same scenario has been measured on the same machine: we would rather show 'measuring' than a number we did not take.

editors.name: VS Code
editors.note: Electron. Windsurf and Devin are VS Code forks and are expected to land in the same range.

metrics.label: Memory at rest
metrics.description: Editor process, a 100k-line file tokenized in the background, no language server.

metrics.label: Memory while opening 100k lines
metrics.description: Streaming open of an 8 MB, 100,000-line file. Typical level, with the peak in the note.

metrics.label: Disk space
metrics.description: Installed program, without user data. The Lumen figure is the release binary built locally.

lumen.note: Release binary; CI fails the build above 30 MB.

metrics.label: Startup to first paint
metrics.description: Process start to the first frame with a project open. Not covered by a test yet, so Lumen is pending too.

metrics.label: Open a 100k-line file
metrics.description: Buffer ready to scroll and edit.

lumen.note: Buffer open in perf.rs; the app-level open is measured separately.

metrics.label: Scroll frame cost
metrics.description: CPU time to draw one frame while scrolling a tokenized 100k-line file (steady state).

metrics.label: Keystroke to frame
metrics.description: Handle a key and draw the frame that shows it, in the middle of a 100k-line file.

metrics.label: TypeScript: first diagnostics
metrics.description: Open a mid-size TypeScript project and wait for the first diagnostics. Lumen runs tsgo (the native compiler); VS Code uses tsserver by default.

metrics.label: TypeScript: language server memory
metrics.description: Resident memory of the TypeScript server on a real project. Lumen's lean mode loads only open files and their imports (range from the README).

lumen.note: Observed 40-220 MB in lean mode, 780 MB for a full 7k-file tsconfig; a controlled run is pending.
